exactDeltas.oldText: 依交互设计读本例实际状态/输入，匹配基准
exactDeltas.newText: 依交互设计读本例实际状态/输入；源条件规则、源初值不自动给另设本例赋值，仅继承实际明确覆盖的共同题设/默认情境。判定必需信息仍缺时，明标教学构造补足或只对依赖结果保无法确定，不从别例擅选；无需逐例重复无关字段。再匹配基准

exactDeltas.oldText: 问题可观察并标材料支持/缺口。
exactDeltas.newText: 问题可观察并标材料支持/缺口；候选疑问句的预设事实也须核源，尤其区分操作许可与成功结果，不能把相矛盾或未知的前提嵌成已知。

exactDeltas.oldText: 初值、赋值/运算、源可达值、允许域、值型分开，可达不证全域。
exactDeltas.newText: 源条件规则与源初值描述源规则或指定情境，不替另设本例的实际输入。共同题设/默认情境只有实际说明覆盖本例及覆写方式才继承；引源、章节号或要求“每题明确”不等于已赋值。先核判定所必需信息；仍缺时不从别例或源初值擅选，可就地明标教学构造给必要值/假设，或只把依赖结果保为无法确定。无需每例重复全部规则/字段，不收紧已知宽许可或不依赖缺项的结论。初值、赋值/运算、源可达值、允许域、值型仍分开，可达不证全域。

preservationMap.proposed: Separate source rule/initial-value evidence from actual independent example input; inherit only an actually stated shared setup/default and overrides, or clearly mark necessary teaching assumptions or dependent indeterminacy.
preservationMap.preserved: Only necessary inputs are required, full source rules/local scope remain reusable, known broad permission and results not depending on missing information remain unchanged.

preservationMap.proposed: Audit actual candidate-question presuppositions against source; distinguish operation permission from successful result, without treating false/unknown premise as known.
preservationMap.preserved: Three-dimensional target differences, recommendation, explicit choice/update wait and allowance for explicitly identified hypothetical/error statements remain intact.

preservationMap.proposed: Exact byte preservation outside three spans; entire interaction reference unchanged.
preservationMap.preserved: Read/text-only/new-guide contract, evidence discipline/background, conflict/gap/three-value logic, complete source actions/local scope/field attribution, simulation/feedback/retry/no score, output adaptation and all existing boundaries.
